description: Na₂Y(MoO₄)(PO₄) is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibca space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.99 Å. Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.46 Å. Mo is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.79 Å) and two longer (1.82 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Y, and one P atom.
